What is a Roth IRA?

By Sam Lee · Updated Nov 2, 2026

A Roth IRA is a retirement account you fund with money you already paid tax on, so qualified withdrawals in retirement are tax free.

How does a Roth IRA work?

A Roth IRA lets your savings grow without tax on the gains, and qualified withdrawals in retirement are tax free. People often open one at a brokerage, choose a fund, and set up a small automatic deposit each month. Can I have a Roth IRA and a 401(k)?
